question.prompt: Circle \(O\) has radius 5. Point \(P\) lies outside circle \(O\), and the length of \(OP\) is an integer less than 8. Find all possible values of \(OP\) (separate them with commas).

solutions.explanation: Since the point lies outside the circle, \(OP>5\). Also, \(OP<8\) and is an integer, so \(OP=6\) or 7.
solutions.title: Combine the distance bounds
